    generateInventoryUsageReport(DatabaseManager) - Method in class Reports
    Generate an inventory usage report showing how much of each ingredient was used during the specified time window based on orders.
    generateSalesSummary(DatabaseManager) - Method in class Reports
    Generate a sales summary string containing: - Total sales (sum of total_price) - List of items sold with aggregate counts across all orders in range The parsing logic expects menu_items stored as a JSON-like map: {"Drink": [a,b,c], ...} We count each key once per occurrence (any quantity encoded inside the tuple/list is ignored for now because the provided structure (a,b,c) meaning wasn't specified).
